images.name: system-architecture
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create one finished, beautiful, exceptionally SIMPLE architecture/function infographic PNG for an AIO Life GitHub README. Landscape 16:9, high resolution. Design language: extremely restrained, clean flat editorial information design. Pure white background, generous whitespace, navy text, very light blue and mint fills, thin quiet borders, modest rounded corners. Carefully balanced professional typography. All Chinese must be accurate and clearly readable. Thin clean connector lines only when explicitly requested. No 3D illustrations, device mockups, gradients, glows, dot grids, textures, shadows, decoration, tiny prose, footnotes, footer, slogans, figure numbers, logos, badges, long technology lists, or marketing artwork. Content should be understood in five seconds, with no redundant text. Large readable labels and perfectly aligned simple cards. This is a two-image series with identical palette, font, spacing, and visual weight. Main header modestly sized in upper left; diagram fills center with wide outer margins.
Header exact: “AIO Life · 系统架构”.
Draw exactly THREE horizontal levels of nodes in a symmetrical top-to-bottom flow.
TOP LEVEL: three equal small cards in one row:
“Web” with smaller “Vue 3”
“Mobile” with smaller “uni-app x”
“AI Client” with smaller “MCP”
No pictograms needed.
MIDDLE LEVEL: one centered wide card, main label “统一业务后端”, smaller label “Spring Boot · Java 21”. Thin arrows from the three top cards converge neatly into this backend card. On the two connections from Web and Mobile, use a SINGLE shared small label “REST”; on the AI Client connection use “MCP”. Do not repeat the text on many arrows.
BOTTOM LEVEL: four equal cards evenly spaced:
“MySQL” / “业务数据”
“Redis” / “会话与缓存”
“MinIO” / “文件存储”
“Neo4j” / “关系图谱 · 可选”
Thin arrows from backend to the four storage cards using a tidy horizontal branch. Dashed arrow and dashed border only for Neo4j. Arrow directions all downward, no crossovers.
There must be exactly 8 nodes total: 3 clients, 1 backend, 4 storage nodes. No business feature lists, ports, container details, or additional supporting components. Nodes white or pale indigo for clients/backend, pale mint for storage. Make it noticeably sparse and simple, like a beautifully designed technical book figure.

images.name: feature-overview
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create one finished, beautiful, exceptionally SIMPLE architecture/function infographic PNG for an AIO Life GitHub README. Landscape 16:9, high resolution. Design language: extremely restrained, clean flat editorial information design. Pure white background, generous whitespace, navy text, very light blue and mint fills, thin quiet borders, modest rounded corners. Carefully balanced professional typography. All Chinese must be accurate and clearly readable. Thin clean connector lines only when explicitly requested. No 3D illustrations, device mockups, gradients, glows, dot grids, textures, shadows, decoration, tiny prose, footnotes, footer, slogans, figure numbers, logos, badges, long technology lists, or marketing artwork. Content should be understood in five seconds, with no redundant text. Large readable labels and perfectly aligned simple cards. This is a two-image series with identical palette, font, spacing, and visual weight. Main header modestly sized in upper left; diagram fills center with wide outer margins.
Header exact: “AIO Life · 功能全景”.
This image is a concise feature map, NOT a technical architecture. Use a perfectly aligned 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX spacious equal cards, no arrows. Each card has one small simple consistent outline icon, one bold Chinese category title, and exactly ONE short line of three feature names below it, with middle dots as separators. Category headings are navy; icons and small category accent may alternate muted indigo and teal. Body labels are dark gray and large enough to read at README width.
The six cards in reading order must use this EXACT text:
1. “时间与任务” then “时迹 · 待办 · 目标”
2. “生活记录” then “阅读 · 观影 · 运动”
3. “财务管理” then “收支 · 银行卡 · 账单导入”
4. “物品与订阅” then “设备 · 衣柜 · 会员”
5. “成长与沉淀” then “闪念 · 笔记 · 里程碑”
6. “连接与管理” then “编程看板 · 关系图谱 · 密码管理”
Choose minimal icons appropriate to each category: clock, book, wallet, box, lightbulb, connected nodes. All icons thin flat line art, same size. Keep equal internal padding and large open gaps between cards. No tiny feature descriptions, no fake statistics, no extra categories, no technology names, no software package identifiers. This is a curated overview of implemented features, so do not add AI chat, offline sync, or planning-only capabilities. Only the header and 6 titles plus 6 feature lines should be visible text.
